snapshot.name: ak:review-pr
snapshot.description: Review GitHub pull requests for correctness, regressions and security. Optional fix, reply and merge modes authorize their respective delivery steps.
snapshot.when_to_use: Invoke to review one or more GitHub PRs by number/URL, optionally fix findings, optionally post the review back to GitHub, optionally merge when ready and watch CI.
snapshot.argument_hint: <PR number or URL> [<PR number or URL> ...] [--fix] [--reply] [--merge] [--advice] [--ultra]
